tools.name: seocluster_whoami
tools.description: Check your SEOcluster.ai subscription tier (free / essential / pro), used and remaining monthly quotas, and connected Google Search Console site projects (including GSC totals freshness timestamp).

tools.name: seocluster_site_ownership
tools.description: Fetch the Google Search Console Target Pages ownership map for a site project before creating or editing pages (Cannibalisation Gate). Supports sorting by conflicts, impressions, or clicks, pagination via offset, optional live GSC timeframe filtering (window_days or post-migration start_date), and l

tools.name: seocluster_list_briefs
tools.description: List saved grounded SEO brief summaries (brief_id, cluster_label, target_url, brief_revision_id, gsc_date_range) for your account, optionally filtered by target URL.

tools.name: seocluster_get_brief
tools.description: Fetch the full saved SEO brief body and any already-saved fail-closed Page Edits (readiness: ready | review_required | withheld, plus readiness_reason) by brief_id at zero credit cost.

tools.name: seocluster_generate_brief
tools.description: Generate and save a grounded SEO content brief from a workspace Target Page's real Google Search Console queries (or an explicit keyword list). Consumes 1 monthly Brief credit (Free: 2/mo, Essential: 50/mo, Pro: 120/mo) unless dry_run=true.

tools.name: seocluster_generate_page_edits
tools.description: Generate copy-pasteable, fail-closed Page Edits (title, meta, H1/H2, section, FAQ schema, internal links) for a saved brief cluster_label. Requires Essential ($29/mo) or Pro ($99/mo); uses 0 credits on <24h cache hit or dry_run=true, and 1 Page Edit credit when generating fresh.

tools.name: seocluster_list_actions
tools.description: List prioritized Google Search Console SEO Actions (quick wins, split-ranking conflicts, technical audit issues, and metadata CTR fixes) for a site URL.

tools.name: seocluster_get_action
tools.description: Fetch a single SEO Action by action_id, including full GSC query evidence, confidence/risk breakdown, frozen baseline metrics, and any post-implementation outcome.

tools.name: seocluster_record_implemented
tools.description: Mark an SEO Action as implemented after shipping code/CMS edits and automatically freeze the live 28-day Google Search Console baseline so post-deploy click/impression lift can be evaluated.

tools.name: seocluster_check_outcome
tools.description: Check post-implementation settle readiness for an implemented SEO Action, and optionally run live after-window Google Search Console lift evaluation (clicks, impressions, and position deltas vs frozen baseline).

tools.name: seocluster_prose_and_geo_gate
tools.description: Run SEOcluster deterministic 50-rule Anti-AI-Tells prose linter (exempting HTML title tag, meta description, and JSON-LD schema) + GEO / AI-Search citation extractability check on candidate Markdown or HTML before committing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seocluster_site_ownership, seocluster_list_briefs, seocluster_list_actions, seocluster_get_action, seocluster_record_implemented, seocluster_check_outcome, seocluster_prose_and_geo_gate · Private data: seocluster_record_implemented · Public sink: seocluster_site_ownership, seocluster_get_action, seocluster_record_implemented, seocluster_check_outcome · Destructive: seocluster_check_outcome, seocluster_prose_and_geo_gate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seocluster_site_ownership, seocluster_list_briefs, seocluster_list_actions, seocluster_get_action, seocluster_record_implemented, seocluster_check_outcome, seocluster_prose_and_geo_gate · Private data: seocluster_record_implemented · Public sink: seocluster_site_ownership, seocluster_get_action, seocluster_record_implemented, seocluster_check_outcome · Destructive: seocluster_check_outcome, seocluster_prose_and_geo_gate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
